title: The Clairaudiograph
subtitle: A voice cut into wax
text: The Mnemonist teaches this at Degree 3 after three personal sample identifications and the Alchemist's referral. Put a filled creature Blood Vial and blank Ambergris Cylinder in the Clairaudiograph. Choose a call and carve for four seconds. Identification is optional. The blood is consumed and its empty vial remains. Preview is private. Play carries the recording up to 32 blocks. A rising redstone edge plays once. Turn on Loop to repeat while powered, or use Play for a manual loop. Stop affects only this machine. A cylinder preserves a sound event, so its audio variation can change between plays. Make two cylinders from Mnemonic Ambergris, Active Befouling Ash, honeycomb wax, and paper.
